kind: ABI 7 named game locations in the real game

mod.note: carries no RVA: asks for string:resource_path by name, then verifies the bytes itself

observed_events.message: info: symbol string:resource_path at rva 36f640 (12 bytes)
info: resource path anchor verified at rva 36f640

meaning: The host published the locations its PE pipeline recorded; the loader re-hashed the live bytes on lookup; the mod independently hashed them again and they agreed. No build-specific number exists in the mod.
limits: Lookups are refused without a verified image, for unknown names, and for hash mismatches (-1/-2/-3). A stale or patched build therefore yields no address rather than a wrong one.
content_policy: Only names, RVAs and hashes are recorded; no game bytes are logged or committed.
